title: Reinstatement of an Expired Homesite Reservation Hold
content:
When an expired hold is reinstated, it is brought back to held status on the same homesite and the reinstated hold term is fixed, the whole calendar days the reinstated hold runs counted from the reinstatement date. A reinstated hold runs the reinstated hold term counted from the reinstatement date, and the hold expiry date written is the reinstatement date plus the reinstated hold term. This applies to every expired Homesite Reservation hold that is reinstated.

## Conditions on the buyer's records

> A lapsed hold is not reinstated until no other reservation of the buyer stands in pending deposit or held status.

> The reinstated hold term is fixed only after a reinstatement fee payment for the lapsed hold stands on the reservation ledger.

Read against the records: while any other Homesite Reservation of the same buyer shows status pending deposit or held, the lapsed hold remains expired; and a lapsed hold whose reservation ledger shows no reinstatement fee payment has no reinstated hold term.

## Business effect

Reinstatement moves the reservation from expired to held, clears its end date, writes its hold expiry date as the reinstatement date plus the reinstated hold term, and records the new count of reinstatements used. Nothing is posted to the reservation ledger by the reinstatement itself.

## Invocation: `reinstate_homesite_hold_f9d4ebfd`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool reinstates an expired Homesite Reservation on the same homesite, putting the homesite back on hold for the buyer.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reinstate_homesite_hold_f9d4ebfd` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reservation_id` | the reference number of the expired Homesite Reservation to reinstate, as returned by the Homesite Reservation lookup for the buyer | identifier |
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the reserving buyer, as returned by the customer profile lookup; written back unchanged as the buyer on the reservation | identifier |
| `hold_days` | the reinstated hold term as a whole number of calendar days counted from the day of the call; the hold expiry date written is that day plus this many days | integer of at least 1, never a fraction |
| `reinstatements_used` | the number of reinstatements written on the reservation once this one is counted: the count on the record before this reinstatement plus one | integer of 0 or more |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `reservation_id`, `status` (always "held" once the call completes), `hold_expiry_date` (the new hold expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `reinstatements_used` (the reinstatement count now on the reservation). A receipt with status "held" means the reinstatement was recorded.

## Input and return illustration (hypothetical)

Called on 2026-08-14 with `hold_days` 9 and `reinstatements_used` 1, the tool returns `status` held, `hold_expiry_date` 2026-08-23 and `reinstatements_used` 1.
